spec_match.rationale: The level × reputation matrix matches the chromestatus summary and the Safe Browsing help doc: the new bypassable pop-up is Enhanced-only for unconfirmed signals; the red interstitial stays for confirmed threats at every level with SB on.

interactive.rationale: Two radio groups drive the verdict, rationale, and the rendered recreation live; all six meaningful combinations produce distinct outputs.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a labelled recreation driven by both axes; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the no-protection footgun (even confirmed sites load silently), the Standard-protection gap for unconfirmed signals, and clean-site no-op.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5427561449521152 and the Safe Browsing help doc.

conformance.rationale: This feature has no web API, so the suite's UI-behavior contracts are honest manual assertions plus the automatable no-surface absence check; the recreation never claims to be the real UI (dashed border + permanent label, disabled prop buttons).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: exercised suspicious/enhanced, suspicious/standard, confirmed, and protection-off paths — verdicts and recreations correct; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: ssw-explorer-outcome asserts on every recompute with the chosen pair.

design_system.rationale: Interstitial recreation uses accent-rose with ivory text (AA for large text); the recreation container is dashed-bordered with an explicit label; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend radio groups; the outcome box is aria-live; recreation buttons are disabled props so they can't be mistaken for working controls.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Control grid collapses under 700px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify the real pop-up copy once observable
openQuestions.detail: The recreation's wording is illustrative — Chrome's actual suspicious-site pop-up strings aren't published in the sources used. When someone can trigger the real warning on Chrome 152 with Enhanced protection, align the recreation's headline/buttons with the shipped UI.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio matrix drives live outcome region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group axes in fieldsets and announce derived outcomes via a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both axes are fieldset radio groups; the outcome box is role=status aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two fieldset layout small screens
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls grid collapses under 700px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all outcome paths recompute correctly on Chromium 141 with the recreation clearly labelled as page-rendered, console clean at both viewports. The real browser UI cannot be triggered from a demo by design; that boundary is stated on the page rather than papered over.
